# PostRoast

> AI roast for X drafts. Sign in, paste a post, get Engage / Warmth / Viral / Payout scores and a rewrite you would ship. Ten free roasts a day. Does not post or schedule on X.

PostRoast (https://www.postroast.app) is a writing tool for people who already post on X. The job is the last pass before Post: tell the writer if the draft will die, then hand them a version they would actually ship.

## Product facts

- Sign-in is required to roast. Email is enough. X sign-in, when offered, is identity only.
- Free plan: 10 roasts/day, 3 saved drafts, 8 critiques/day.
- Pro: $19/month. Unlimited roasts and roast history. Draft and critique caps stay.
- Studio: $32/month. Unlimited roasts, drafts, and critique.
- Founder: $199 once. Lifetime Studio. 100 seats, then it closes.
- Compose on X opens a draft with the first post. Remaining thread posts are copied. PostRoast does not get posting permission and does not schedule.
- Public roast cards publish only when the user clicks share.
- We do not sell drafts. We do not invent star ratings or customer counts.

## Scores

- Engage: will anyone stop.
- Warmth: does it sound like a person.
- Viral: will anyone pass it on.
- Payout: can this post-shape earn X Original Content Rewards, ignoring follower count. Replies do not earn.

The roast is an opinion, not a guarantee of reach or payout.

## FAQ

- Do I need an account to roast a post? Yes. Sign in, then you get ten free roasts a day.
- Does PostRoast post or schedule on X? No. Compose on X opens a draft. We do not take posting permission.
- Pro vs Studio? Pro is unlimited roasts and history. Studio adds unlimited drafts and critique.
- Is the roast a guarantee? No. It is an opinion about the draft.
- What happens to a draft? Stored for the roast and history. Public only if you share. Not sold.
